start.text: (The train lurches. Your box lands on an aunty's foot.) Aiyyo! Whose furniture is this? Is this a metro or a godown?

choices.text: Sorry, aunty — I'll hold it up till Majestic.
It's the metro, aunty. Everyone has bags.
Give her the spot by the door.

overloaded.text: (Four boxes. On the brake before Majestic, the top one slides, hits the pole, and the whole coach laughs — the aunty loudest.) Next time take two trips, beta!

hold.text: Hmph. Good boy. My son would have left it on my foot and checked his phone.

argue.text: Everyone has bags. Not everyone has a table. (She moves her foot. The glare stays.)

move.text: (You shuffle into the corner with the boxes. The aunty takes the door spot like a throne.) Thank you, beta.
